skills.note: Wind-up with the fan flicking open, a whip-fast straight thrust, then the fan spins away on a horizontal line and bursts far past the left edge (flash, fireball, shock ring, sparks, paper shreds, smoke). No enemy is drawn. The clip ends on the reference plate.

Crouch, tuck, one full forward somersault screen-left (about 110 px of root travel), land in a tuck and rise. Rotation follows the travel and the ball keeps ground contact. Frame clips cannot carry root motion, so the last frame is the reference plate.

Layered flame tongues, big back flames, peeling licks, rising embers, a pulsing glow and a ground pool, all behind the reference plate. The burn cycle loops. Opaque character pixels are not repainted.
